description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Dediyawala, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District (25/0039)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and property ownership matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including details of parcel numbers, owners, extents, encumbrances, and cadastral information. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it focuses on land registrations, property ownership, and title settlements.
